svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.whale-forelimb-skeleton-model", "source_master_path": "tactile/masters/education/anatomy/skeletons/whale-forelimb-skeleton-model.svg", "source_master_sha256": "77d6aae2da5bf36ebd9e614680c54395e6496ba5920447c5b5562e419bc61c24", "page_fit_revision": {"status": "regenerated", "method": "Explicit mathematical construction in millimetres; original physical strokes retained and Index dots freshly placed. No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The introduced humpback whale regional forelimb retains one humerus, separate radius and ulna, one grouped wrist, and four unsegmented digital-ray regions II-V. The two central ray regions remain longer than the lateral ones; no digit I is added. At page size all bone/region polygons are widened outward by 1.3 mm after relaying their source positions; the grouped wrist is shifted 1 mm distally to preserve its gaps. Fine contour proportions change; the rays deliberately do not enumerate metacarpals or phalanges and must not be interpreted as single biological bones. No flipper soft-tissue outline, anatomical specimen length or generic all-whale pattern is claimed.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "The introduced humpback whale regional forelimb retains one humerus, separate radius and ulna, one grouped wrist, and four unsegmented digital-ray regions II-V. The two central ray regions remain longer than the lateral ones; no digit I is added. At page size all bone/region polygons are widened outward by 1.3 mm after relaying their source positions; the grouped wrist is shifted 1 mm distally to preserve its gaps. Fine contour proportions change; the rays deliberately do not enumerate metacarpals or phalanges and must not be interpreted as single biological bones. No flipper soft-tissue outline, anatomical specimen length or generic all-whale pattern is claimed. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending.
